result:
I've made all the fixes for the five findings (F-DG0-001, -002, -003, -005, -203), but the two required checks have not run, so the task isn't complete. Every Bash call failed because the permission classifier returned no verdict. As a result, `python3 tools/source/merge_register.py`, `node tools/gates/validate.mjs --register DG0` and `git rev-parse HEAD` / `git status` are all BLOCKED, and I couldn't confirm the starting revision.

That also means `docs/delivery/requirements.csv` and `master-prompt-coverage.csv` still reflect the previous pass (AN-04). Once Bash is back, the orchestrator needs to run the merge, then the validator. I checked the quoting and 19-column count of every changed row by reading them, and fixed one comma I had introduced into an unquoted cell of `mp-coverage-s01-s13.csv`. That doesn't replace running the merge.

**Changes by finding** (in `docs/analysis/**`):
- **F-DG0-001:** REQ-PB-049 now covers per-transformation weight sets, the 100% check and versioning, and completes at DG3 (P3). The new REQ-PB-093 covers admin default weights and rubrics in Playbook Studio at DG5 (P5), citing B0077 and M0176. Both coverage rows, the stage plan, acceptance map, field inventory and README are updated.
- **§21 recheck:** checking every "evidence required before approval" clause (M0403–M0410) found two more mismatches, both fixed:
  - **DG2:** no row finishing by DG2 proved that invalid approvals are blocked. REQ-S04-003..005 now require a 403 for a non-approver or the submitter and a 409 for a stale version. REQ-S04-006 got the same for G4 at DG3.
  - **DG5 "durable rule retries":** REQ-S12-020 and REQ-S12-021 moved from DG6 to DG5. This is my reading of that clause, and a reviewer may prefer a split instead.
- **F-DG0-002:** G5 is approved by the Executive Sponsor by default, configurable to the Business Owner per T11 "Go-live / scale", the same pattern as G3. The playbook's gate table names no approver, B0018 has the Sponsor approve major trade-offs, and B0099 names the Business Owner for go-live/scale. The permissions matrix now has a T11 "Go-live / scale" row, the Sponsor has Rv on the TOM row, and rule 7 says initiative-level go-live decisions are separate records that feed G5.
- **F-DG0-003:** I checked all 93 SOURCE rows. 90 now use the form "Playbook (B…) / Master-prompt additions / Interpretations", and the "no interpretation beyond the cited blocks" wording is gone. PB-042, -058 and -069 already separated these and are unchanged.
- **F-DG0-005:** Journey and Modular mode are fixed, plus nine more terms that were narrower or ambiguous. A revision table in `glossary.md` gives the reason for each. All Arabic terms still need review by a Mobily Arabic-language owner.
- **F-DG0-203:** the stage plan now has a 28-row test-ownership table and per-stage test bullets for P1–P7. P6 extends and re-runs the suites; only A17 and the first A19 restore drill start there. A07 is now first delivered in P3.

**Addendum:** REQ-DLV-026 and REQ-DLV-032 now list specific files (the ten `.claude/agents/*.md`, `docs/delivery/agents.md`, `tools/agents/run-agent.sh`, `tools/gates/tests/validator.test.mjs`) instead of directories. Rows that passed validation last round already cite all of these files.

**Other changes:**
- I corrected two stale requirement IDs in `user-journeys.md`.
- I made one mistaken write attempt to `docs/scratch-unused.txt`; the write guard blocked it and no file was created.
- The new REQ-PB-093 line in the CRLF `req-pb.csv` may have an LF line ending.

**Expected after the merge:** 411 rows (SOURCE 93, USER 188, ENGINEERING 130). By final gate: DG0 19, DG1 11, DG2 32, DG3 32, DG4 137, DG5 78, DG6 48, DG7 54. I worked these counts out by hand, so they need confirming against the merged register.

The handback is `docs/delivery/handbacks/DG0/T-DG0-AN-05-transformation-analyst.md`. It records all three checks as BLOCKED.
